entries.basis: Stars and Stripes Korea reproduces Dynamic Busan local newspaper guide, explicitly credited July edition; no original day/year exposed. Exact Namcheon branch: 25-4 Suyeong-ro388beon-gil, matches native pin/MICHELIN. Quote concerns interior atmosphere, not a fabricated firsthand diner or numeric subscore.
